title: The 10 elements
at a wedding
dinner
tag_line: Tag the one who yam sengs the loudest.

items.Yang Wood: Gives the speech nobody asked for. Nails it.
items.Yin Wood: Knows which table has the best gossip.
items.Yang Fire: Leads the yam seng. Loudest in the ballroom.
items.Yin Fire: Cries at the slideshow. Every single time.
items.Yang Earth: Arrives early. Finds the table. Saves seats.
items.Yin Earth: Makes sure everyone gets a piece of lobster.
items.Yang Metal: Hongbao amount decided weeks ago. Exact.
items.Yin Metal: Best-dressed at the table. Outfit steamed.
items.Yang Water: Table-hops all night. Knows everyone now.
items.Yin Water: Quietly reads the room. Knows who's sulking.
